from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class FairValueChangeRecord(BaseModel):
    """Fair value change gain/loss data extracted from one financial report."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="The company name the report belongs to")
    fair_value_change_income: float | None = Field(description="公允价值变动收益 (fair value change income) amount in yuan; from consolidated income statement")
    non_recurring_amount: float | None = Field(description="非经常性损益 related to fair value change if mentioned in the document")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period (e.g., '2024 Q1')")
    has_data: bool = Field(description="True if the financial report contains the fair value change line item, False if it's blank or missing")
    quote: str = Field(description="A short excerpt showing the line item and value")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    fair_value_change_records: list[FairValueChangeRecord]
